doctor.crypto.title: Crypto & audit compatibility (mixed-version fleet check):
doctor.crypto.audit_default_key: ✗ audit chain uses the public default HMAC key (anyone who reads the source can forge audit records)
doctor.crypto.audit_default_key_desc: Audit chain uses the public default HMAC key; records can be forged
doctor.crypto.audit_default_key_hint:
Migrate to a dedicated random key (this starts a new chain; archive the old one first):
  1. aflare audit export --out archive.json (export and keep the old chain before the key change)
  2. Back up and move the existing audit log file away
  3. A random key file (audit-hmac.key) is generated automatically on first write to the new chain
  Or configure a shared env key: export AFLARE_AUDIT_HMAC_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
doctor.crypto.audit_key_file: ✓ audit HMAC key: per-install random key file (audit-hmac.key)
doctor.crypto.audit_key_env: ✓ audit HMAC key: configured via environment variable
doctor.crypto.audit_disabled: ⊘ audit log not enabled (no history dir)
doctor.crypto.audit_read_fail_desc: Failed to read the audit log
doctor.crypto.audit_none: ⊘ no audit log yet (created after the first workflow run)
doctor.crypto.audit_sha256: ✓ audit chain: %d records, all SHA-256 (verifiable by pre-0.9.0 binaries)
doctor.crypto.audit_sm3: ✗ audit chain: %d of %d records are SM3-signed; pre-0.9.0 binaries cannot verify them
doctor.crypto.audit_sm3_desc: Audit chain has %d SM3 record(s); older binaries cannot verify them
doctor.crypto.audit_sm3_hint:
SM3 records are irreversible (the audit chain is append-only). For mixed fleets:
  - Upgrade all machines to 0.9.0+ (aflare self-update); old binaries just can't verify, appending stays safe
  - Switch new records back to the default: unset AFLARE_AUDIT_HMAC_ALGO
doctor.crypto.secrets_none: ⊘ no secrets store yet (created on first save)
doctor.crypto.secrets_aes_v1: ✓ secrets store is AES-256-GCM (v1 format; pre-0.9.0 binaries cannot read it)
doctor.crypto.secrets_aes_legacy: ✓ secrets store is AES-256-GCM (legacy format; pre-0.9.0 binaries can read it)
doctor.crypto.secrets_sm4: ✗ secrets store is SM4-GCM; pre-0.9.0 binaries cannot read it
doctor.crypto.secrets_sm4_desc: Secrets store is SM4-GCM; older binaries cannot read it
doctor.crypto.secrets_sm4_hint:
To roll back to the old-version-readable format:
  1. export AFLARE_SECRETS_CIPHER=aes-gcm
  2. Trigger any save (e.g. aflare secrets set with the same value) to rewrite the store in the legacy format
doctor.crypto.warn_hmac_sm3: ⚠ AFLARE_AUDIT_HMAC_ALGO=sm3 is set: new audit records will be SM3-signed (upgrade all binaries before enabling)
doctor.crypto.warn_cipher_sm4: ⚠ AFLARE_SECRETS_CIPHER=sm4-gcm is set: the next save re-encrypts to SM4-GCM (older binaries cannot read it)
